title.zh-CN: Agent 运行看板：从状态到人工介入

summary.en: Controlled snapshots power Board, List, Inbox and Insights, extended with read-only dependencies, source usage history and virtual lists with comparable rendering measurements.

summary.en: Use a nine-column table to separate selection, activation, filtering, forms and overlays into independently installable capabilities.

summary.zh-CN: 把组件元数据与交互示例分开，让目录、词典和文章在主动预览前保持轻量。
summary.en: Separate metadata from interactive examples so the catalog, dictionary and articles remain lightweight until a preview is requested.
